title: Reverse Engineering Graph (AetherRE Megazord) MCP Integration Configuration

antigravity.comment: Place inside ~/.gemini/antigravity/mcp_servers.json or workspace mcp configuration

cursor.comment: Place inside .cursor/mcp.json or Cursor Features Settings -> MCP
